messages:
matt: Heads-up — deploy-bot clamped canary to 5% for r2023 due to quota guard. Can we bump to 10% for the A/B branch? Need to confirm telemetry gating.

lina: what's the guard that tripped? can you link the error/metric snapshot?

deploy-bot: [automated] Detected quota_guard_violation: GPU_POOL_ERLANG=0.82. Action: clamp_traffic -> 5%. Change window: 2024-11-03 02:00-06:00 UTC. Requester: matt.

sara: The A/B requires 10% for statistical power. Can we relax the throughput guard if latency/error are within thresholds? e.g., allow override when p95<=300ms and error_rate<=0.5% for 10m.

lina: agree to conditional override, but ops needs a manual approval step in console. UX idea: show current guard metric, suggested override button, and a one-click revert. No silent overrides.

matt: quick config suggestion to make it explicit:
```
traffic_split:
  - variant: control
    pct: 90
  - variant: experiment
    pct: 10
guard:
  latency_p95_ms: 300
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
  sustained_minutes: 10
fallback: roll_to_control
```

oliver: telemetry query for p95 I used locally:
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, latency_ms[10m])
```
I'll add a dashboard panel and a per-route alert.

qa-bot: canary smoke run summary -> experiments=1, samples=12k, errors=0.3%, p95=285ms -> PASS :white_check_mark: (detailed logs uploaded to /artifacts/r2023/canary-smoke.log)

sara: great. lina — can you add the manual approve step in the change window and set timeout 15m? also need an audit note for the override.

lina: done. added "Approve traffic override" step to the deploy flow in console, timeout=15m, audit required with reason field. commit: r2023-clamp-negotiation.

matt: thanks — i'll kick the canary to 10% in ~5m and watch. tagging @oliver for dashboard alert thresholds.

oliver: will create alerts: p95 > 320ms OR error_rate > 0.7% -> temporary chat hook to #releases-live. also adding a sliding window check to avoid flapping.

matt: logged runbook entry: docs/runbooks/releases/r2023-clamp-negotiation.md :memo: (contains steps for manual rollback, deploy-bot commands, and postmortem checklist)

sara: 👍

matt: update: pushed to 10% at 2024-11-03 02:18 UTC. monitoring...

qa-bot: quick follow-up: post-override smoke at 10% -> errors=0.35%, p95=290ms, samples=4k -> still PASS.

lina: closing the approval ticket in the console. keeping the guard rule in read-only for 2h before auto-relax.

matt: thanks everyone. filing a small follow-up to product to expose a one-click "request temporary guard loosen" flow in the rollout UX.
